messages.content: Propose an ordered list of hypotheses from the registered IDs only. Choose model structures only; do not estimate numeric parameters. Return an object matching this JSON schema exactly: {"items":[{"hypothesis_id":"SENSOR_BIAS","rationale":"…","evidence_refs":["obs:0:1.200"]}]}.
